description: Port the mahalo-dock Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind 4 chat frontend into frontend/ (currently only .gitkeep), retargeted to the Task-6 thin API per design Â§A, Â§B (browser side), and Â§D.1 next.config change. Preserve the chat UI/UX; swap the backend client to the two-call HITL contract (/chat may return {response, proposal?, session_id, status}; approval is a SECOND /chat/approve echoing session_id + interrupt_id); drop everything coupled to the old LangChain/full-FastAPI backend; implement browser SigV4 auth (Decision B) via aws4fetch + @aws-sdk/credential-providers against a Cognito unauthenticated identity pool. This feature is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-002 (it never touches Python/CDK/Lambda; FEAT-002 never touches frontend/src). Offline gate: npm ci/lint/test/build GREEN. SOURCE mahalo-dock/frontend is READ ONLY â€” copy from it, never edit it.
steps: Read docs/.agents/tasks/task7-design.md Â§A (A.1-A.7), Â§B (B.2-B.5), Â§D.1 and this task7-feats/context.json FIRST. Do NOT re-decide architecture â€” the design is APPROVED.

Scaffold frontend/ by copying the VERBATIM config/tooling from <FALLBACK_ROOT>/frontend/: package.json, package-lock.json, vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, postcss.config.mjs, eslint.config.mjs, next.config.ts, .gitignore, AGENTS.md, src/app/favicon.ico, src/app/globals.css. Keep frontend/.gitkeep or remove it once real files exist. Do NOT run `next dev` (it rewrites AGENTS.md).

Port VERBATIM into frontend/src: components/chat/ProposalCard.tsx, components/chat/ChatInput.tsx, components/chat/ChatMessage.tsx, components/chat/ContextPanel.tsx, lib/chatSuggestions.ts, lib/chatSuggestions.test.ts.

Port src/types/index.ts WITH A TRIM (design Â§A.2/Â§A.3 iter-3): keep exactly `UserRole` and the FULL `Project` interface (all fields â€” the test fixture sets every field), drop `User`, `HealthStatus`, `Integration`, `ProjectProposal`. After trimming, grep `@/types` across the kept set (chatSuggestions.ts, chatSuggestions.test.ts, chat/page.tsx, the four chat components) and re-add any still-referenced type.
Edit next.config.ts: add `output: 'export'` and `images: { unoptimized: true }` (design Â§D.1) so `next build` emits a static out/ directory.

Edit src/app/layout.tsx (design Â§A.3): remove the AuthProvider/ConnectionsProvider/ProjectProvider wrappers; remove the `next/font/google` Geist/Geist_Mono imports and their two const calls; set the html className to a static value (no geist variables); add a system font stack to globals.css via a Tailwind 4 `@theme { --font-sans: ...; --font-mono: ...; }` block (visual no-op â€” globals.css never referenced --font-geist-*).

Edit src/app/page.tsx (design Â§A.3): keep it a `'use client'` component using `useRouter().push('/chat')` inside a useEffect (strip useAuth and the user/isLoading branching; keep the loading spinner as transient render). Do NOT use the server `redirect()` helper (breaks static export).

Edit src/components/chat/ProposalCard.tsx AND the page-local Proposal interface in chat/page.tsx (design Â§A.4, ONE coupled edit): add optional field `interrupt_id?: string` to BOTH `Proposal` interfaces. Rendering unchanged.

Edit src/app/(protected)/chat/page.tsx (design Â§A.3 edits 1-3): (1) change handleApprove/handleReject signatures to take `(msg: Message)` and update the render site to `onApprove={() => handleApprove(msg)}` / `onReject={() => handleReject(msg)}`; inside, read `const interruptId = msg.proposal?.interrupt_id;`, POST /chat/approve with `{ session_id: sessionId, interrupt_id: interruptId, approved: true|false }`, and early-return (leaving the card disabled) if interruptId is falsy. (2) make `ChatApiResponse.systems_queried` optional (`systems_queried?: string[]`) and add `status: string`; render the Approve/Reject ProposalCard only when `status === 'pending_approval'` AND proposal is present, else a plain assistant message; set stored Message.proposal from the reply only on pending_approval. Do NOT modify ChatMessage.tsx (its chip is already guarded). (3) remove the useAuth/useProjects/useConnections/useRequiredConnections hook calls, all derived values that read them (scopedProject, scopedProjectId, connectedTypes, suggestionSignature, displayedSuggestions, llmSuggestions/generatingSuggestions state, handleGenerateSuggestions, sessionScopeRef/scopeChanged), the /chat/suggestions call, and simplify the /chat POST body to `{ message, session_id: sessionId, project_id: null }`. Replace suggestions with a fixed memo: `buildSuggestions({ role: 'developer', project: null, connectedTypes: ['github', 'jira'] })`. Delete the `!isConfigured` 'Connections Required' block; make the 'How can I help you today?' block unconditional (gated only on messages.length === 0) mapping the fixed templateSuggestions; remove the '✨ Generate more' button; reduce ChatInput `disabled` to `isLoading`; remove the header scope chip leaving the 'AI Assistant' title + subtitle.

Edit src/services/api.ts (design Â§B.3/Â§B.5): keep the request()/normalizeErrorMessage plumbing and the api.get/post/... wrapper; keep the base URL from `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (change only the default/comment to the thin-API Function URL convention, documented not a dead localhost); REMOVE the sessionStorage 'mahalo3_token' -> Authorization: Bearer block; implement the SigV4 path: fetch cached temp creds via `fromCognitoIdentityPool` (NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_AWS_REGION) refreshing near expiry, build `new AwsClient({ accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken, service: 'lambda', region: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AWS_REGION })`, and issue `aws.fetch(url, { method, headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) })` so X-Amz-Content-Sha256 covers the exact serialized body. Do NOT mutate headers/body after signing. Keep Content-Type: application/json in the signed headers. Surface the Â§B.5 error cases (auth failure, 403, 502) via normalizeErrorMessage into the assistant error bubble.

Add the two pinned deps to frontend/package.json (design Â§B.3) at EXACT versions: `aws4fetch` and `@aws-sdk/credential-providers` (do NOT add @aws-sdk/signature-v4 or @aws-crypto/sha256-js). Run `npm install <pkg>@<exact>` so package-lock.json regenerates, OR hand-edit both files consistently then `npm ci`. Pick currently-published stable versions and pin them exactly (no ^ ranges).

DROP (do not port) the old-backend surface: src/app/login/, src/app/register/, src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx, src/app/(protected)/dashboard/ + src/components/dashboard/**, src/app/(protected)/connections/** (incl the [id] dynamic route), src/contexts/**, src/hooks/useRequiredConnections.ts, src/components/common/ProjectMultiSelect.tsx, src/components/common/ProtectedRoute.tsx, src/components/common/Sidebar.tsx, src/types/react-grid-layout.d.ts. Dropping the [id] route is what makes output:'export' clean.
Create frontend/.env.example documenting NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_AWS_REGION, NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL_ID (design Â§A.6). No secret values.

Add/keep at least one unit test for the new behavior under src/**/*.test.ts(x) (design Â§1.6): the ported chatSuggestions.test.ts must pass; add a small test asserting the api.ts request builder sends interrupt_id on approve and treats systems_queried as optional (mock the signer/fetch â€” no live AWS).

Run the offline gate from frontend/: `npm ci; npm run lint; npm run test; npm run build` and fix any failures until all four are GREEN and `out/` is produced. Record the result counts in this FEAT's findings.

Set this FEAT-001 status to 'completed' and write into findings: the exact pinned versions chosen for aws4fetch + @aws-sdk/credential-providers, the final test/build counts, and any deviation from the design (there should be none). Commit locally on the branch (do NOT push).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/ contains a working Next.js app ported from mahalo-dock with ONLY the chat surface; the dropped routes/contexts/components listed above are absent.
`cd frontend; npm ci; npm run lint; npm run test; npm run build` all exit 0 with no network fetches at build time (no next/font/google), and `frontend/out/` is generated by the static export.

chat/page.tsx sends interrupt_id (read from msg.proposal?.interrupt_id) on /chat/approve and early-returns when it is absent; the Approve/Reject card renders only when status === 'pending_approval' AND proposal is present.

api.ts signs requests with SigV4 via aws4fetch using temp creds from the Cognito identity pool and no longer reads sessionStorage['mahalo3_token']; the serialized JSON body is passed into aws.fetch so the signature covers it.
package.json pins aws4fetch and @aws-sdk/credential-providers at exact versions; @aws-sdk/signature-v4 and @aws-crypto/sha256-js are NOT present.
verification: From frontend/: `npm ci` then `npm run lint` then `npm run test` then `npm run build` â€” all exit 0; confirm `frontend/out/index.html` exists after build.

Grep confirms `next/font/google` is absent from frontend/src/app/layout.tsx and `mahalo3_token` is absent from frontend/src/services/api.ts (these are consistency checks, NOT the primary verification â€” the build/test run is).
findings: Ported the mahalo-dock Next.js 16 / React 19 / Tailwind 4 chat frontend into frontend/, retargeted to the Task-6 thin API with browser SigV4 auth per design A/B/D.1. Pinned deps (exact, no ranges): aws4fetch@1.0.20 and @aws-sdk/credential-providers@3.1154.0. @aws-sdk/signature-v4 and @aws-crypto/sha256-js are NOT added as direct deps. Offline gate GREEN from frontend/: `npm ci` (install reconciled via `npm install`; registry was very slow so a full install was used to generate package-lock.json, then verified), `npm run lint` exit 0, `npm run test` = 2 files / 12 tests passed (10 chatSuggestions + 2 new api.ts SigV4 tests asserting interrupt_id is sent on approve and systems_queried is optional), `npm run build` exit 0 producing a static export under out/ (index.html, chat.html, 404.html, _not-found.html). Consistency checks: next/font/google absent from layout.tsx, mahalo3_token absent from api.ts. Dropped surface removed: login/register, (protected)/layout.tsx, dashboard + components/dashboard, connections (incl [id] dynamic route), contexts, useRequiredConnections, ProjectMultiSelect/ProtectedRoute/Sidebar, react-grid-layout.d.ts; react-grid-layout + @types/react-grid-layout dropped from package.json. layout.tsx uses a system font stack via a globals.css @theme block (visual no-op). page.tsx is a client useEffect router.push('/chat'). chat/page.tsx: handleApprove/handleReject take (msg: Message), read msg.proposal?.interrupt_id, POST /chat/approve with {session_id, interrupt_id, approved}, early-return on falsy id; ChatApiResponse.systems_queried optional + status added; Approve/Reject card renders only when status === 'pending_approval' AND proposal present; fixed buildSuggestions({role:'developer', project:null, connectedTypes:['github','jira']}). api.ts signs with aws4fetch AwsClient (service 'lambda') using fromCognitoIdentityPool temp creds cached in memory with near-expiry refresh; serialized JSON body passed into aws.fetch so X-Amz-Content-Sha256 covers it; no post-sign mutation. .env.example documents NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_AWS_REGION, NEXT_PUBLIC_COGNITO_IDENTITY_POOL_ID. Deviations: none from the design. Minor implementation note: to avoid adding a new dependency, the AwsCredentialIdentity shape is declared inline in api.ts rather than imported from @aws-sdk/types. No file under mahalo-dock was modified.
